text: This report provides an update on the Polar Bear Life Support System (LSS) and Redirection of Tundra Trail Project awarded to Pine Valley Corporation.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (May 23, 2025) from the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, Toronto Zoo for information. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 23, 2025) from the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, Toronto Zoo remain confidential in its entirety as it contains information about litigation or potential litigation that affects the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo.
